THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Threshold for Goods & Services under the applicable Procurement Legislation; published on the Procurement intranet page, not in this PDF

THRESHOLD_WORKS.description: Threshold for Works; published on the Procurement intranet page, not in this PDF

THRESHOLD_CONCESSIONS.description: Threshold for Concession contracts; published on the Procurement intranet page, not in this PDF

THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Threshold for Light Touch contracts; published on the Procurement intranet page, not in this PDF

THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.description: 'the (relevant/appropriate) Threshold' where the PDF does not say which: resolves per contract to the GOODS_SERVICES, WORKS, CONCESSIONS or LIGHT_TOUCH parameter by contract category

rules.condition: service contract with estimated value exceeding the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: consider how the procurement or contract might improve economic, social and environmental wellbeing (Social Value Act 2012 and Social Value Policy)
rules.evidence_source: procurement file: recorded social value consideration
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: contract made under a recorded decision
rules.approver: the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.evidence_source: decision record (Council/Executive minutes or delegated decision)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision: 4.1.1 of the Council; or 4.1.2 of the Executive; or 4.1.3 within the Council’s Scheme of Delegation by:

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: contract covered by an existing budgetary provision in the approved Budget
rules.evidence_source: budget code and approved Budget on the purchase order / commitment
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: treat the award as a Key Decision
rules.evidence_source: Forward Plan entry and Key Decision record
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Service Director without delegated authority to enter into the contract
rules.required_action: obtain approval before award
rules.approver: as set out in Appendix A
rules.evidence_source: award approval record dated before award
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: publish the expenditure
rules.evidence_source: published Expenditure over £500 data
rules.verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish: 5.1.1 Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for goods and/or services with a value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of the invitation to tender
rules.evidence_source: published transparency data on invitations to tender
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: every contract in progress or awarded
rules.required_action: publish a contract register with value, duration and supplier
rules.evidence_source: published contract register
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: contract information held by service areas
rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly
rules.evidence_source: monthly contract reports to the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis

rules.condition: contract opportunity advertised by a Service Director
rules.required_action: advertise electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal advert records
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council’s Procurement Portal to ensure that such opportunities also appear on the Central Digital Platform (CDP) database.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a Further Competition under a compliant Framework)
rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP before any other advertising medium
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice and its publication date versus other adverts
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc).

rules.condition: every CDP notice
rules.required_action: CDP notice approved and issued by the named officer
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice approval and issuer record
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.evidence_source: spend and order data by supplier over time
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with an estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender; tenders submitted via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal ITT and tender submission records
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: every electronic tender
rules.required_action: specify submission format; store tenders locked until the opening date and time
rules.evidence_source: Invitation to Tender and Procurement Portal lock/opening log
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the opening time and date
rules.required_action: reject late tenders unless the exception applies
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal submission timestamps and any Monitoring Officer decision
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: every tender submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: tenders opened electronically by a Procurement Officer with an audit record
rules.evidence_source: e-tendering system opening audit record
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: every quote and tender
rules.required_action: evaluate against criteria notified in advance
rules.evidence_source: invitation documents (criteria) and evaluation record
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: every contract award not on the most advantageous / best value basis
rules.required_action: award to the most advantageous, best value quote or tender (not only lowest price)
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (for exceptional circumstances, in advance)
rules.evidence_source: evaluation and award report; any prior Service Director approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: exception or waiver of competition for a contract with a value of more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: exception only on the grounds in 7.2.1 (urgency, not subject to Procurement Legislation) or 7.2.2
rules.evidence_source: exception/waiver record stating the 7.2.1 or 7.2.2 ground
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: exception under the discretion ground
rules.required_action: record the reasons in writing
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.evidence_source: written record of reasons
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: seek any waiver in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: waiver/exception register: grantor and date requested versus contract date
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: exception approval record
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospectively only for urgency)
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, consulting the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director
rules.evidence_source: exception report and relevant board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board; recommendation to the Executive
rules.approver: Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: exception report, board and Corporate Board approvals, Executive decision
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: fully document; submit a written exception report to the relevant board in advance
rules.evidence_source: exception report and its submission date to the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: 7.5.1 be fully documented; 7.5.2 for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer records consideration and satisfaction that circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S.151 Officer's recorded consideration on the waiver
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: obtain advice confirming 8.2.1-8.2.3 before using the scheme
rules.evidence_source: recorded advice confirming entitlement, coverage and compliance of the Purchasing Scheme
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: produce a written procurement report
rules.evidence_source: procurement report on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.condition: every 9.1 report
rules.required_action: keep the report for three years
rules.evidence_source: retained 9.1 reports
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: every procurement, regardless of value
rules.required_action: document procurement progress and keep it for three years from award
rules.evidence_source: procurement file: communications, deliberations, documents, award
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: every purchase
rules.required_action: hold written (or electronic) evidence of the purchase
rules.evidence_source: purchase order / invoice / electronic record
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: contracts detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: contract in writing in an approved form
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: signed written contract
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every sealed contract
rules.required_action: Legal Services retain sealed contract documents
rules.evidence_source: Legal Services sealed-document records
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: every contract award
rules.required_action: notify the award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register
rules.evidence_source: Council Contract Register entry
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: include the standard clauses
rules.evidence_source: contract document versus Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement

rules.condition: amended Standard Form of Agreement
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: approval of the amended form
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every contract (where appropriate)
rules.required_action: include the minimum clauses in 10.7.1-10.7.10, including payment within 30 days
rules.evidence_source: contract document clauses (10.7.1-10.7.10)
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment
rules.evidence_source: Data Protection Impact Assessment on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.evidence_source: written authorisation on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: contract estimated to exceed £500,000 for works (or supplies/services by a date or dates)
rules.required_action: consider requiring a performance bond of at least 10% of contract value
rules.evidence_source: contract file: performance bond or recorded decision
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a contract is estimated to exceed £500,000, in value or amount and is for the execution of works (or for the supplies or services by a particular date or series of dates) the relevant Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond (for an amount equal to at least 10% of the value of the contract)

rules.condition: contract with a performance bond
rules.required_action: bond in approved form and included in the ITT
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.evidence_source: bond form approval and Invitation to Tender
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: 11.2 contract where a performance bond is not considered necessary
rules.required_action: written risk assessment kept on the contract file
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: written risk assessment and approval on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: 11.4.1 undertake a risk assessment in writing; and 11.4.2 seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and 11.4.3 keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: assess contract risk; where insurance is needed set levels and check cover in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: contract risk assessment; insurance levels and certificates
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: contract above the Threshold
rules.required_action: contract sealed
rules.evidence_source: sealing register entry
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (or officers nominated by them in writing)
rules.evidence_source: award decision record
rules.verbatim_quote: up to relevant Threshold Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: written report provided and approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: relevant Service Director, following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: written award report and relevant board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000 Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Key Decision; written report approved by the relevant board; made under the Call-In and Forward Plan rules
rules.approver: relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder
rules.evidence_source: Key Decision record, written report and relevant board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided:

rules.condition: Total Contract Value £2.5million or more
rules.approver: Executive
rules.evidence_source: Executive decision / quarterly procurement report
rules.verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval

rules.condition: Total Value (excl. VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: seek at least one quote from an appropriate source
rules.evidence_source: quote on file for the purchase
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £1,000 and less than £25,000 At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods/services, Total Value (excl. VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal invitation-to-quote records
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: goods/services, Total Value (excl. VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP contract notice (Contracts Finder)
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (excl. VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal invitation-to-quote records
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (excl. VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP contract notice (Contracts Finder)
rules.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (excl. VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: full competitive tender; at least five written tenders sought via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender records
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (excl. VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: place an advert on the Portal with information on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Portal advert and CDP notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal. An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: Total Value (excl. VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Procurement Legislation procedure: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate)
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender records
rules.verbatim_quote: Above Threshold Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: Total Value (excl. VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: place an advert on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice (Contracts Finder / Find a Tender)
rules.verbatim_quote: Above Threshold Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal. An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: contract excluded under the Procurement Legislation (no competition)
rules.required_action: approval obtained before award
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: prior written Monitoring Officer approval; board approval where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: record key decisions and follow the PSR process
rules.evidence_source: PSR decision records
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: award under a Purchasing Scheme with no further competition
rules.required_action: approval obtained before award
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: prior written Monitoring Officer approval; board approval where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) of a type where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken on behalf of the Council or other public sector organisation; or Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for extension
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S151 Officer approval of the extension
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: permitted variation of scope, contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: prior written approval
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: prior written approvals of the variation
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: permitted variation of scope, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: report submitted to the relevant board with Monitoring Officer and S151 recommendation
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.evidence_source: extension/variation report and relevant board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: social care placement or package listed in a)-f)
rules.required_action: record the reasons for the choice of provider on the case notes
rules.evidence_source: individual's case notes
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: contract under an Appendix C exemption with annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.evidence_source: relevant board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.

notes.note: 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes VAT; Appendix B bands are 'Total Value exclusive of VAT'.
7.2.2 lets an Executive Director and/or Chief Executive except a contract at their discretion; 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant an exception.
1.4 lists four Threshold categories (Goods & Services, Works, Concession, Light Touch); App B footnote *** lists three (works and concessions together).

App B row C ('above £500,000 and less than the Threshold') implies the works/concession/light touch Threshold exceeds £500,000; App A row 1 ('up to relevant Threshold') then overlaps row 3 (£500,000–£2.5m Key Decision) and row 2 is empty.
Same overlap for exceptions: if the relevant Threshold exceeds £500,000, 7.4.1 ('up to the Threshold') and 7.4.3 ('over £500,000') both apply and 7.4.2 is empty.
App A row 2 is 'less than £500,000' and row 3 'Above £500,000': a contract of exactly £500,000 has no award authority.
Row label says '£2.5million or more' but the text says 'in excess of £2.5million'; exactly £2.5m is unclear.
Appendix B starts 'Above £1,000': no requirement is stated for contracts of £1,000 or less.
Variation approvals are set for value 'below' and 'greater than' the Threshold; a value equal to the Threshold is not covered.
Row E concerns variations of scope but requires an 'extension report'.
Row C circumstance does not parse ('no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken ... or').
Placeholder cross-references 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)'; the document title is also 'Part []'.
7.4.2 reads 'provided and an exception report' and refers to urgency 'unless 7.3 applies', but 7.3 says nothing about urgency (7.2.1 does).
6.23 'Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders' is a sub-heading numbered as a clause.
5.2 and 5.2.1 continue the list of items 'councils must publish' under 5.1 but are numbered as separate clauses.
7.1 and 7.7 both say the exclusions are set out in Appendix C.
Footnote *** is not referenced anywhere in the Appendix B table.
App C closing note uses 'annual or total value'; 6.15 defines value as the total over the full potential duration.
Above Threshold, 'at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate)' leaves when five are needed undefined.
'the relevant board' is used throughout but never defined.
6.8 says opportunities 'should' be advertised on the Portal; 6.10 says above-threshold ones 'must' go on the CDP first. Only 6.10 is mandatory.
6.11 refers to tenderers from 'other member states', which no longer fits UK procurement law.
Advertising above £500,000 says an advert 'should' be placed, not 'must', unlike rows B1/B2.
